Name: BFAV Unicorns (Early Test Version)
Author: cantabileChaos
Description:
I made this mod a while back, but haven't had time to fully test it because of work so I wanted to post an early version for everyone to play around with and offer suggestions for.

There are 37 different unicorn variants in both natural and unnatural colors.

They take a long time to mature, but as adults they will find magic in the earth which can be turned into many different products as well as seeds for magical crops.

PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING: One of the current glitches I've experienced with the mod is that the colors on the magic sunflowers can sometimes blink in and out rapidly. Please exercise caution if something like this could be dangerous for you!
